**Directions: Examine the four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options, pick the one that gives its correct order.**

A. These young cadets undergo a rigorous training program that is aimed to prepare them for the Armed Forces.

B. Finally, after the Senior Secondary examination, these cadets compete to qualify for entry into the National Defence Academy located in Pune.

C. It is also referred to as the Cradle of Excellence which trains cadets from the early age of 12.

D. Nestled in a lush green campus of 18 acres in Dehradun Cantonment is the RIMC, the Rashtriya Indian Military Academy.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'DCAB'.

__
 
• The sentence 'D' is independent of any other sentence as it is giving general information about "the **Rashtriya Indian Military Academy**". Hence, 'D' is the first part.
 
• Sentence C will come after D because it explains what **the Rashtriya Indian Military Academy is referred to as and what actually happens inside it**.
 
• Sentence A will come after C because it explains how the young cadets are trained in **the Rashtriya Indian Military Academy**.
 
• The sentence 'B' is the concluding part because it explains what happens finally with the cadets or how they qualify further to get into the **National Defence Academy**.

 

Paragraph after rearranging the sentences__: *Nestled in a lush green campus of 18 acres in Dehradun Cantonment is the RIMC, the Rashtriya Indian Military Academy. It is also referred to as the Cradle of Excellence which trains cadets from the early age of 12. These young cadets undergo a rigorous training program that is aimed to prepare them for the Armed Forces. Finally, after the Senior Secondary examination, these cadets compete to qualify for entry into the National Defence Academy located in Pune.*

 __

questions.question:
**Directions: In the given sentence, identify the segment which contains the grammatical error.**

I have made it a point to call my teachers on September 5 as a token of mine gratitude.

options.text: it a point to call my teachers

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**of mine gratitude**' i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the use of the pronoun 'mine' is incorrect.
 
• The pronoun 'mine' means **of or belonging to me**.
 
• ''**Mine**'' comes **at the end of a dialogue**. The **noun comes before** ''**mine**''.
 
 
• **For example,** *That black and brown clock is **mine***.
 
 
 
• The pronoun 'my' also means of or belonging to me.
 
• ''My'' comes **before a noun or object **(here, **gratitude**)** in a sentence**. It is **followed by a noun **(here, gratitude).
 
 
• For example, ***My** clock is black and brown*.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the pronoun 'my' should be used in place of the pronoun 'mine'.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct sentence: *I have made it a point to call my teachers on September 5 as a token **of my gratitude***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिए गए वाक्य में pronoun 'mine' का प्रयोग गलत है।
 
• Pronoun 'mine' का अर्थ है मुझसे संबंधित या मेरा।
 
• संवाद के अंत में ''**mine**'' आता है। Noun, '**mine**' से पहले आता है।
 
 
• **उदाहरण:** *That black and brown clock is mine*.
 
 
 
• Pronoun 'my' का भी अर्थ है मेरा।
 
• ''**My**'' एक वाक्य में noun या object (यहाँ, gratitude) से पहले आता है। इसके बाद एक noun आता है (यहाँ, gratitude)।
 
 
• उदाहरण: *My clock is black and brown*.
 
 
 
• इसलिए, pronoun 'mine' के स्थान पर pronoun 'my' का प्रयोग करना चाहिए।

 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 है।

सही वाक्य: *I have made it a point to call my teachers on September 5 as a token of my gratitude*.

The correct answer is '**thoughtful**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence "*Studies report that such deep reading leads one to become sensitive and ___(5)___ citizens of the community*'' is indicating the benefits of reading.
 
• The use of the word ''sensitive'' in the sentence indicates **that one is conscious of and able to understand people’s feelings, problems, etc**.
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'thoughtful'(Adjective).
 
• The word 'thoughtful' means **thinking about what other people want or need**. 
 
 
• Example:* She's a very kind and **thoughtful** person*.

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

The complete passage is: *In order to promote reading, we must become role models for the young by setting (1) aside our own smartphones to lose ourselves in a book. We too (2)should switch off our devices and set aside space and time to (3)reignite old habits that once transported us to the world of (4)imagination. Studies report that such deep reading leads one to become sensitive and (5)thoughtful citizens of the community.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let us explore the other options:

 
 
• '**Thoughtfully**' means **in a way that suggests being absorbed in thought**. (विचारपूर्वक, अच्‍छी तरह विचार करके)
 
• '**Thoughtless**' means **not thinking about what other people want or need or what the result of your actions will be**. (बेपरवाह; स्‍वार्थी या बेलिहाज़)
 
• '**Thoughtfulness**' means **the state of being absorbed in thought**. (विचारमग्‍नता, ध्यानमग्‍नता, भरपूर सावधानी)

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

• वाक्य में 'sensitive' शब्द का प्रयोग इंगित करता है कि व्यक्ति, लोगों की भावनाओं, समस्याओं आदि के प्रति जागरूक और समझने में सक्षम है।
 
• इसलिए, रिक्त स्थान में भरने के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द 'thoughtful' है।
 
• 'Thoughtful' शब्द का अर्थ है** दूसरों की इच्‍छा या आवश्‍यकता का ध्‍यान रखने वाला; लिहाज़ी, विचारवान**।
 
 
• उदाहरण: *She's a very kind and thoughtful person*.
 
 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 है।
